body: REDGARDEN commit d2e30bb. docs/HEROES_VS0.md already specced Tyler as an exact Meepo reskin (real OG clone-death rule) well before code existed for it. True multi-clone spawning isn't buildable without touching the draft/pick/connection model every hero depends on -- simplified and documented honestly: Q roots+DoT (Earthbind), W is a real blink-strike (Poof), R (Divided We Stand) keeps the actual risk/reward point as a self-buff leaving Tyler's own armor negative for its duration, not literal shared-fate clones. ARENA_HERO_COUNT 17->18.
title: 18th hero, TYLER: honest simplification of the OG Meepo-clone design
